variable_under_test: USE_IDF 0->1 (with bg_stats over Phase-1 QA corpus) vs EXP-001 (no-IDF); all else identical
command: flock GPU1 (MASTER_PORT=29501); USE_IDF=1 BG_STATS_PATH=outputs/phase1_selfdistill_qwen512/bg_stats.pt SLOT_SELECTION=tfidf GRANULARITY=per_layer TOP_T=64 TARGET_MODE=cartridge_plus_doc KEY_MODE=freeze RIDGE_LAMBDA=1e-4 RIDGE_SCALE=spectral DELTA_WEIGHT=1e-2 AM_EXECUTION_MODE=per_document PHASE1_CACHE_PATH=outputs/phase1_selfdistill_qwen512/cache_last.pt SYNTH_DATA_PATH=data/qasper/train/qwen_qasper_MT_task_8192.parquet MODEL_NAME=Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 NUM_TOKENS=512 EVAL_QA_PATH=... EVAL_MT_PATH=... bash examples/qasper2/scripts/train_continual_am_sparse.sh
observations: Closed-form AM-sparse WITH IDF gating (the true canonical), single variable USE_IDF=1 vs EXP-001's USE_IDF=0, everything else identical (same Phase-1 cache, same bg_stats collected over the Phase-1 QA corpus, per_layer, top_t=64, freeze keys, ridge 1e-4 spectral). Result: IDF HURTS BOTH axes. QA-forgetting 2.6351 (ppl 13.9) is +0.383 WORSE than EXP-001's 2.2521, and MT-acquisition 3.0073 (ppl 20.2) is +0.465 WORSE than EXP-001's 2.5426. Both deltas are >2x the tiny-eval noise band (~0.2), so this is a real effect, not noise. value_global_max_abs dropped to 486 (from EXP-001's 816), confirming IDF genuinely changed which slots were selected (not a no-op) — so this is a valid single-variable comparison. Counterintuitively IDF worsened retention too (it was supposed to steer away from Phase-1/QA-heavy slots to protect QA), which indicates the IDF/document-frequency signal is the wrong gate in this compressed-KV-cartridge setting: pure attention-mass (TF) on the new doc selects slots that are both better for acquisition AND less disruptive to Phase-1. This SUPPORTS HYP-G1 (attention_mass/pure-TF beats TF-IDF) and directly validates the project's stated core problem ('TF-IDF selects slots with insufficient attention mass'). Caveats: single run, single seed, tiny evals (QA n=6, MT n=5) though deltas are large; tested only at top_t=64 per_layer (literature says IDF matters more at small t -> HYP-a5 at top_t=32 is the natural follow-up). CONCLUSION: the canonical AM-sparse baseline going forward = the NO-IDF config (EXP-001).
